column1: # The cells of the conversion table as test cases, see docs/spec/conversion.md.
# Columns: source type, source value, target type, expected target value.
# Text in [] keeps its blanks. A c, n, d or t source holds exactly the characters given, padded with blanks; any
# other source is the given text converted to its type. Targets read as: text in [], x and xstring as hex digits,
# f as the hex digits of its IEEE 754 bits, decfloat as its coefficient digits d.ddd with a four-digit exponent,
# p with all its decimals, utclong as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss.fffffff (empty when initial). EXC: names the exception
# raised, DUMP: the runtime error that ends the program.
